verdict.rationale: Justworks marketing claims support for onboarding international employees and contractors 'without the legal complexity of setting up an entity,' implying an EOR-style model, but there is no documented detail on how this works (countries covered, compliance, contracts, benefits) beyond a single homepage tagline. Missing for 10: detailed EOR mechanics, country coverage list, owned-entity payroll option details, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
